Escrevi um e-mail Agora para os advogados

Dear Amber and Jerry, I hope you’re both well. I have been trying to speak to Aya all day today. I called Rony, the nanny, and his assistant. The nanny informed me that he has given her strict orders not to pass the phone to Aya when I call, unless he allows it. (She mentioned that she could lose her job if he finds out she told me this.) He is currently in NYC and did not inform me or offer the right of first refusal. (Photos attached.) This is just one of the many issues I am currently dealing with. I am tired of sitting by and watching him act as a bully repeatedly and now violate the agreement. Please let me know what action we can take.
